description:
Spring Framework 7 line of the CadenzaFlow Keycloak identity plugin, for
	  Spring Boot 4 / the cadenzaflow starter-4 family. Identical sources to
	  the primary artifact, recompiled against spring-web 7: Spring 7 changed
	  binary signatures the 6-compiled jar depends on (HttpHeaders no longer
	  implements MultiValueMap, so e.g. the HttpEntity constructors take
	  HttpHeaders now), which makes the primary jar fail with
	  IncompatibleClassChangeError on a Spring 7 classpath.
